result:
Round 103 is implemented and waiting for C. I haven't claimed any of C's acceptance rows, and I made no commits, pushes, installs or server changes.

**Changes** (HEAD still `b6c9716`; 5 modified files plus 1 new; all 532 frozen files and the protected files are unchanged):
- **Stall watchdog, `export-wav.client.ts`:**
  - If the WAV worker sends nothing for 30 s, the export fails with `WAV-ის ჩაწერა შეჩერდა — worker 30 წამი არ პასუხობს.` and the worker is stopped once.
  - Every progress message restarts the 30 s count.
  - When the worker reports an error, its own text now appears after the existing message, e.g. `WAV-ის ჩაწერა ვერ მოხერხდა (worker). boom`. A blank message and the other failure paths show the existing message unchanged.
  - Six new tests, EW8a–f, are appended to `export-wav.test.ts`.
- **Cancel just before downloads (CU10):** a new test covers a cancel that lands after the MP3 encode finishes but before the downloads start. I kept it because deleting that pre-download cancel check turns it red 3/3, and it is green 3/3 otherwise. A side check now fails the test if the timing it depends on ever shifts.
- **PU tests runnable alone:** the first PU4 now runs in its own first block, and the main block opens the import gate first. All 8 test bodies are byte-identical to before.
- **Docs:** the status line in doc 090 is updated, and doc 091 is new, in Georgian.

**Checks**
- Typecheck, lint and Biome on my files all pass with no findings from my files.
- The 9 targeted test files pass, 100/100. I didn't run the full suite, `verify` or the build; the gate runs those.
- **Tests on the old code:** EW8a, b, c, e and f fail, and EW1–EW7 pass. Two results differ from B's prediction:
  - EW8d passes on the old code, because the old abort path was already correct. Only the mutation that stops abort clearing the timer turns it red.
  - EW8c fails on the old code, because the old code still passes a late progress message on after `complete`.
- **Mutations:** each of the eight targeted changes turns its intended tests red, and the unmutated code is green 3/3.
- **Correction to the task:** on the old file, `-t "PU2"` fails by assertion, not by the 15 s timeout. `-t "PU1"` and `-t "PU3"` pass on the old file, because they don't need the encoder. So B's "same for PU1" doesn't hold; C's row only requires PU2 to fail on the old file.
- **My own browser check** (1280, the worker replaced by a test stub):
  - the error text shows exactly;
  - the stall message appears 30.2 s after the stub worker starts, with the worker stopped once and 0 downloads.

  The other browser rows, including Cancel during a stall, MP3 and the slowed-CPU run, are C's.

**Code-reviewer:** 8/10. It found a real bug my timer introduced: a late progress message could restart the timer, stop the worker a second time 30 s later, and update progress after the export had ended. I fixed it with one shared cleanup step, `detachWorker`, and added tests for it. I also added the CU10 timing check it asked for.
- **Not changed:** adding a 15 s timeout to the new first block would make Biome re-indent the test bodies; that test takes 274 ms anyway. Worker error text can be long and in English; B ruled out a length cap this round. Renaming the EW5 title isn't possible in an append-only file.
- **Not re-reviewed:** the reviewer only saw the version before these fixes. My mutation re-runs cover the fixes, but the gate's review should look at them. The reviewer also couldn't run `git diff`, so I checked the append-only and identical-body claims by script; C should re-check them.

**Architecture note (verbatim, a proposal for B/root):** "Signal 4 (a new timer and listener lifecycle added to an existing owner): `/home/runner/czaba-project/store/app/lib/arrangement/export-wav.client.ts:37-104`. Keep it there, because it is one promise lifecycle in one function and doesn't touch audio timing, refs or the public hook. Proposal for the planner: one task that adds a local `settle()` helper used by all five ways the promise ends, accepted when the "progress after fail/complete" test from Suggestion 1 passes and EW5 and EW8a–f stay green." My `detachWorker` fix already does this inside the owned file.

The exact next C checks are listed at the end of the report.
